title: Agent enrolment request schild.agent_enrolment/0.1 (v0.3, MVP-11)
description: Payload of the DSSE envelope `schild agent enrol` sends once to the gateway (payloadType application/vnd.schild.agent-enrolment.v0+json). Signed by the new agent key itself (proof of possession): the one signature names `keyid` and verifies with `public_key`. The one-time code proves that an admin of the gateway created the enrolment; the admin still confirms the agent in the dashboard. See host-check.md section 5.

code.description: One-time enrolment code from the dashboard (16 characters, 80 bits).
